canonical_surface.opener: triple quote followed immediately by CRLF or LF
canonical_surface.closer: triple quote on an otherwise indentation-only physical line

outer_token.payload_leaf_partition: delimiters, text, escapes and hole leaves partition every source byte EXACTLY_ONCE

part_variants.semantic_role: direct String content after margin removal and logical-newline normalization
same closed escape set as ordinary String
R15 expression parsed under interpolation lexical goals

pipeline.rule: recognize exact triple quote and require immediate CRLF or LF
scan raw physical lines, hole spans and structural balance without precommitting goal-sensitive embedded token kinds
recognize closer only in the outer MULTILINE_STRING frame on an otherwise indentation-only line
compute the longest exact common space/tab prefix of all nonblank content lines; closer indentation is structural metadata only
remove the computed common prefix from literal-text line prefixes, discard blank-line horizontal bytes, normalize internal CRLF/LF to U+000A, and retain the raw coordinate map
materialize each embedded token tape lazily through the parser-owned R16 lexical-goal cursor, then parse shorthand with R17 and braced expressions with R15
plain payload becomes HIR literal/ConstString; any hole becomes the existing HIR interpolation plan and ordered builder transaction

indent_profile.closer_indent: exact space/tab prefix before the committed closer; structural and coordinate metadata only
indent_profile.nonblank_line: a content line whose bytes after horizontal indentation and before its terminator are nonempty
indent_profile.computed_common_prefix: longest byte-exact prefix shared by every nonblank content line
indent_profile.admission: every finite content-line set admits one deterministic computed_common_prefix; closer indentation does not constrain it
indent_profile.no_nonblank_lines: computed_common_prefix is the empty byte string
indent_profile.blank_line_projection: discard all horizontal indentation bytes and preserve only an internal logical line terminator
indent_profile.extra_indent_after_margin: preserved as literal text or embedded-code trivia according to the owning part
indent_profile.projection_failure: internal contract violation; one invalid-literal CST node and no canonical AST

mode_and_balance_protocol.outer_closer_eligible: only when current frame is the original outer MULTILINE_STRING and no interpolation frame is open
mode_and_balance_protocol.braced_close_eligible: only matching } at interpolation delimiter depth zero outside nested string modes
mode_and_balance_protocol.outer_closer_seen_while_interpolation_op: ordinary embedded-source tokenization followed by unbalanced rejection; never close outer literal
mode_and_balance_protocol.out_of_order_close: one deterministic error tree and no canonical AST/HIR/MIR

scanner_owns: physical line facts and raw spans
parser_owns: R16 lexical-goal cursor and lazy embedded token-tape materialization
scanner_parser_handshake.part_order: strict raw source span order; adjacent TEXT may coalesce only with an exact fragment map

lexical_goal_cursor.shorthand: R17 STRING_SHORTHAND transaction parameterized by MULTILINE_STRING host mode
lexical_goal_cursor.materialization: lazy, checkpoint-bound, raw-span preserving, full-span consuming

cst_ast_hir_mir.cst: MultilineStringLiteralCst retains raw token, payload, delimiters, indentation, every part and all coordinate rows
cst_ast_hir_mir.interpolated_mir: DM-LR-TOP-INTERPOLATION-R1 BUILDER_BEGIN, ordered BUILDER_STAGE, BUILDER_COMMIT on success
cst_ast_hir_mir.publication: after every direct segment and display hole succeeds
cst_ast_hir_mir.rollback: reverse acquired-temporary cleanup; publish no partial String

diagnostic_binding.escape_or_embedded_parse: existing ordinary String/parser diagnostic when exact; otherwise IR-FE-P1-035
